---
title: "Our Beliefs"
---

*Below are some concepts we at the American Beaver Party strongly believe in and fight to support. More, in-depth outlines can be found on any of our social media sites below. Stay tuned for new updates.*

## Regarding Economy:

**The economy is a *tool* of the people and should be designed to provide a simple uncomplicated pathway to prosperity.** Economy is not the goal but rather a *bridge* to the development and enjoyment of an enriched life. 
	Creating a maintenance economy where energy, interest rates, cost of goods and inflation remain fixed at the *lowest* levels possible is the duty of good government. Accomplishing this requires a transition in thought. People need to understand that the goal is not the pursuit of money but rather embracing a beautiful and loving personality. The economy should support that *goal*.

## Regarding Energy:

**In pursuit of an economy that remains constant, energy management is crucial.** *Electrical* energy needs to be cheap and plentiful. Once established, the demand for energy remains constant. Transition to energy sources that protect the *environment* as much as possible. All aspects of energy generation, transmission and procurement are owned and controlled by the *general public*.
	Facilitating this transition, the *general public* also owns and controls the oil and gas industries. All prices are stabilized and constant without reason. Export and import of oil is limited and in support of our trading partners. Any profit derived would be a public benefit.
	*Local* electrical energy is the advanced solution to energy production, environmental protections and prosperous local economies. Energy, food and shelter are the foundation of the economy and when all are healthy *prosperity* soon follows; with prosperity comes a *renaissance*.  


## Regarding the United Nations:

**The United Nations is an invaluable tool that can be used to solve *international* issues and conflicts.** It is mandatory that we reconstruct this organization by eliminating the impediments to action.
	Redesigned as an organization providing an open forum for addressing grievances, advancement of creative solutions, shared reasoning, collective decision making and the ability to enforce action.
The United Nations, with proper application, may well divide the world into two orders. One that supports a democratic world, where people are free to determine their own destiny and another that wants to subjugate people into a controlled existence. How these two world orders interact and communicate with each other is the function of the United Nations.
There are no solutions to conflict without the United Nations, excepting enduring war. The United Nations presents a democratic process for peaceful existence for all the countries of the world. It is not a perfect solution but if we can arrive at coexistence without war and destruction, we win. 
Those Nations that continue to imprison the minds of their people must be given the respect and time to evolve, for the sake of the people governed. Likewise, the Nations who provide liberty for their people can pursue life without the constant threat of hostile action.
